Definition: Machlah, the name apparently of two Israelitesses
BiblicalUsage: Mahlah was one of the five daughters of Zelophehad, named in Numbers 27:1 when the sisters came to ask for their father's inheritance, and again in Joshua 17:3 when the land was divided. Numbers 36:11 says Mahlah and her sisters married their father's brothers' sons, keeping the inheritance inside the tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mahlah's story shows that God hears a plain request for what is fair, and that He answers it without taking anything from anyone else.
